index_owned_bytes is unavailable: libart has no allocation hook and no byte accounting, and estimating it from node counts would be an invention rather than a measurement. adapter_owned_bytes covers exactly one container -- the deque of values that libart's leaves point at, counted at its live size because a deque's element storage is not its capacity. There is no key arena: libart copies each key into its own leaf, so keeping one would be a redundant second copy of every key. retained_input_bytes is 0: the harness rows are passed straight to libart, which copies what it needs. Because the index's own bytes are unavailable here, THIS ADAPTER'S MEMORY FIGURE IS NOT COMPARABLE with an implementation that reports its own.
